tags.name: broadcast
tags.description:
AdminBroadcastService manages pushes the team sends to every user. Every RPC requires the
admin role; other callers get FORBIDDEN before the request is validated.

tags.name: content
tags.description:
AdminContentService manages the team's content. Every RPC requires the admin role; other
callers get FORBIDDEN before the request is validated.

tags.name: user
tags.description:
AdminUserService finds accounts and acts on them. Every RPC requires the admin role; other
callers get FORBIDDEN before the request is validated. No RPC returns private couple content.

tags.name: couple
stats
tags.description:
AdminStatsService returns the dashboard summary. Requires the admin role; other callers get
FORBIDDEN.

get.summary: ListBroadcasts returns broadcasts newest created first.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor of the previous page; empty for the first page.

post.summary:
CreateBroadcast adds a draft. At most one of content_id and url is set; content_id must
name published content (NOT_FOUND otherwise).

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

get.summary: GetBroadcast returns one broadcast with its delivery counters.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

delete.summary: DeleteBroadcast deletes a draft; otherwise BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

patch.summary: UpdateBroadcast edits the set fields of a draft; otherwise BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

post.summary:
SendBroadcast queues a draft for delivery to every user; otherwise BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT.
Delivery runs in the background; poll GetBroadcast for status and counters.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

get.summary: ListContents returns content newest updated first, without units.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor of the previous page; empty for the first page.

post.summary: CreateContent adds a draft with its units numbered 1..n in the given order.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

get.summary: GetContent returns one content with its units.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

delete.summary: DeleteContent deletes content that was never published; otherwise CONTENT_PUBLISHED.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

patch.summary: UpdateContent edits the set fields. Published content must stay complete (CONTENT_INCOMPLETE).

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

post.summary:
PublishContent publishes complete content (else CONTENT_INCOMPLETE). Idempotent;
published_at is set on the first publish only.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

post.summary: AddUnit appends a unit after the last one.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

delete.summary:
DeleteUnit deletes a unit of never-published content and renumbers the rest 1..n;
otherwise CONTENT_PUBLISHED.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

patch.summary: UpdateUnit edits the set fields of one unit.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

post.summary: UnpublishContent hides published content from the catalogue. Idempotent; a draft stays a draft.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

get.summary: ListCouples returns couples newest created first.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor of the previous page; empty for the first page.

get.summary: GetCouple returns one couple with per-feature content counts.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

post.summary:
UnpairCouple makes the non-creator member leave through the app's own leave flow; the
couple returns to waiting with the creator and all of its content intact. The creator never
leaves. Idempotent: a waiting couple (creator alone) is returned unchanged.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

get.summary: GetStats returns counters computed on request.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

get.summary:
ListUsers searches accounts newest first. q matches phone, email and name as a
case-insensitive substring, and telegram_id exactly when it is a number.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text; empty matches every account.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
UNSPECIFIED matches any status.

 - USER_STATUS_BLOCKED: Refused at sign-in and on every authenticated request.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor of the previous page; empty for the first page.

get.summary: GetUser returns one account card; deleted accounts are returned with deleted_at set.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

post.summary:
BlockUser blocks an account and revokes every session; its access tokens stop working on
the next request. Idempotent. ADMIN_SELF_ACTION on the caller, CONFLICT on a deleted account.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

post.summary:
DeleteUser deletes an account through the same flow as the user's own deletion.
ADMIN_SELF_ACTION on the caller, CONFLICT when already deleted.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

put.summary:
SetUserPlan sets the plan. expires_at is allowed only with PRO and must be in the future
(INVALID_INPUT otherwise); FREE clears it. CONFLICT on a deleted account.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

put.summary:
SetUserRole grants or removes the admin role. ADMIN_SELF_ACTION on the caller, CONFLICT
on a deleted account.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

post.summary: UnblockUser lets a blocked account sign in again. Idempotent. CONFLICT on a deleted account.

default.description: Error envelope: success is false and error.code is the app error code.

year.description:
Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 to specify a date without
a year.

month.description:
Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 to specify a year without a
month and day.

day.description:
Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0
to specify a year by itself or a year and month where the day isn't
significant.

Date.description:
* A full date, with non-zero year, month, and day values.
* A month and day, with a zero year (for example, an anniversary).
* A year on its own, with a zero month and a zero day.
* A year and month, with a zero day (for example, a credit card expiration
  date).

Related types:

* [google.type.TimeOfDay][google.type.TimeOfDay]
* [google.type.DateTime][google.type.DateTime]
* [google.protobuf.Timestamp][google.protobuf.Timestamp]
Date.title:
Represents a whole or partial calendar date, such as a birthday. The time of
day and time zone are either specified elsewhere or are insignificant. The
date is relative to the Gregorian Calendar. This can represent one of the
following:

tags.description: Replaces the whole list when update_tags is true; ignored otherwise.

counts.description:
Rows per feature: events, lists, wishes, goals, album_photos, documents, letters,
messages, cards, contacts, shelf_items. Every key is always present.

AdminCoupleSummary.description:
AdminCoupleSummary is a couple and its members, without any of its content. It lives here,
not in couples.proto, because it embeds AdminUser and proto imports cannot be circular.

plan_expires_at.description: Absent when the plan does not expire.

couple_id.description: Empty when not in a couple.

deleted_at.description: Absent unless the account is deleted.

AdminUser.description: AdminUser is an account as the admin panel sees it.

photo.description: Absent when there is no profile photo.

couple.description: Absent when not in a couple.

active_sessions.description: Refresh sessions not revoked and not expired.

expires_at.description: Only with PRO; absent means the plan does not expire.

content_id.description: Library content the push opens; empty when unset.

url.description: External link the push opens; empty when unset.

sent_count.description: History rows written (the push may still have failed on a device).

requested_by.description: Admin who sent it; empty for a draft.

Broadcast.description: Broadcast is a push to every user, in each user's language.

BroadcastStatus.description:
BroadcastStatus is the delivery state of a broadcast.

 - BROADCAST_STATUS_DRAFT: Editable; not sent.
 - BROADCAST_STATUS_QUEUED: Waiting for the delivery job.
 - BROADCAST_STATUS_SENDING: Being delivered page by page.
 - BROADCAST_STATUS_SENT: Delivered to every user.

content_id.description: Id of published library content; optional.

tags.description: Lowercased, trimmed and de-duplicated; 1–30 characters each, at most 10.

cover_media_id.description: Id of a Media uploaded via MediaService with MEDIA_PURPOSE_CONTENT_COVER; optional.

units.description: May be empty; numbered 1..n in this order.

next_cursor.description: Empty when there are no more broadcasts.
Empty when there are no more contents.
Empty when there are no more couples.
Empty when there are no more accounts.

users_new_1d.description: Accounts created in the last day.

users_new_7d.description: Accounts created in the last 7 days.

users_new_30d.description: Accounts created in the last 30 days.

pushes_sent_24h.description: Notification history rows written in the last 24 hours.

Stats.description: Stats is the dashboard summary. Deleted accounts are not counted.

UnitInput.description: UnitInput holds a new unit. Units need a body and/or a url depending on the content kind.

UserPlan.description: UserPlan is the subscription tier of an account.

UserRole.description: UserRole is the access level of an account.

UserStatus.description:
UserStatus is the moderation state of an account.

 - USER_STATUS_BLOCKED: Refused at sign-in and on every authenticated request.

url.description: Empty when the content has none.

cover.description: Unset when the content has no cover.

units.description: Ordered by index; empty in list responses.

published_at.description: Set on the first publish and never changed; unset for content never published.

unit_count.description: Number of units. The app API fills it everywhere; admin responses fill it only where units are included.

Content.description: Content is an article, book, podcast or video published by the senbilan team.

ContentKind.description: ContentKind is the format of a piece of content.

ContentStatus.description: ContentStatus is the lifecycle state of a piece of content: draft → published → unpublished.

Language.description: Language is the interface language chosen by the user.

url.description: Public URL valid for reading; may be time-limited.

Media.description: Media is an uploaded file (profile photo, wish photo, message photo) referenced by id.

body.description: Markdown; empty when the unit has none.

url.description: Empty when the unit has none.

Unit.description: Unit is one ordered part of a content: a chapter, an episode or a course part.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Error envelope returned with every non-2xx status.

request_id.description: Request id, echoed in the X-Request-Id header.

code.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE app error code; clients branch on it, never on message.

details.description: Field violations; empty unless code is VALIDATION_FAILED.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying; present only for rate-limited errors.

reason.description: Broken validation rule id, e.g. string.min_len.
